description: Save one named value in your pocket. Writing the same key again replaces it, so this is also how you update a note.

key.description: Name of this value inside the pocket, e.g. 'results'.

secret.description: The `secret` returned by vault_create, starting with `abp_`. Shown once; it cannot be recovered.

value.description: Text or JSON, as a string.

vault_id.description: The `vault_id` returned by vault_create, e.g. '409dffac-b97a-4ed5-8844-f838e2f21ee8'. A UUID, not the label.

name: vault_write
